# Vendored offline map assets

- `ol-10.6.1.js` and `ol-10.6.1.css`: OpenLayers 10.6.1, BSD-2-Clause.
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ol/v/10.6.1
- `land-110m.json`: `world-atlas` 2.x 110 m land topology, generated from
  Natural Earth data. The package code is ISC licensed and Natural Earth data
  is public domain.
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/world-atlas

These files are stored locally so the navigation plot can render a coarse
world coastline and route without a network connection. They are not official
nautical charts and must not be used as a substitute for approved charts.
